change_policy: Change over 21 actual cached canonical D1 rows in the causal known-value series, never recompute past feature rows from later revisions.
publication_policy: At end of realtime_start day in America/New_York, find first existing canonical XAU session opening no earlier than this bound. First permitted decision is the close of that full session. No virtual weekend sessions.
purpose: Implement and verify necessary four-source B components using only already retrieved archives and cached XAU decision clocks. Not a four-source replacement arm; full B remains closed without GLD/COT.
selection_policy: At each decision update observation states only from permitted published vintages. Select the most recent observation whose current known version is numeric; a missing revision removes that observation from the numeric set. Retain observation date and release provenance. No extrapolation, no backward fill, no future revision end as input. Carry known data between publications; this is component readiness, not complete source-frequency or full-B admission.
